headings.title: Special fund deposit and public inspection of collection records
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 5 and history note. headings.title: Limits on repeal or amendment and voter repeal petitions

headings.title: Mutual exclusivity with section 238.235 sales taxes
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 1998 S.B. 861, A.L. 2003 H.B. 668). Makes this section inapplicable to section 238.235 taxes and prohibits imposing a tax under this section if a district has imposed a tax under section 238.235.

headings.title: Eligible whole-jurisdiction districts and voter approval prerequisites
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 including subdivisions (1)–(2) and history note. headings.title: Ballot form and majority approval or resubmission rules

headings.title: Certified resolution notice to revenue director and effective date
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 4 and history note. Requires forwarding a certified resolution copy to the director of revenue by registered or certified mail within ten days of adoption and sets the effective date on the first day of the second calendar quarter after notice.

headings.title: Special trust fund deposit, dedicated use, and investment
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 5 and history note. Requires deposit into a special trust fund solely for the designated transportation purpose (continuing after expiration or repeal) and permits investment of surplus funds.

headings.title: Permitted tax rates and district-wide uniformity
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 6 and history note. Authorizes rates of one-eighth, one-fourth, three-eighths, one-half, or one percent on retail sales taxable under sections 144.010 to 144.525 at a uniform district-wide rate.

headings.title: Seller privilege tax and combined-rate reporting
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 7 and history note. Imposes a seller privilege tax under sections 144.010 to 144.525 and DOR rules at the resolution rate, reported and returned on the combined state, district, and other applicable rate.

headings.title: Director of revenue administration, collection, and enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 8 and history note. Assigns all administration, collection, enforcement, and operation functions to the director of revenue jointly with other Missouri sales taxes.

headings.title: Applicability of state and local sales tax and confidentiality laws
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 9 and history note. Incorporates sections 144.010 to 144.525, sections 32.085 and 32.087, and uniform confidentiality section 32.057, except as modified in this section.

headings.title: Sales tax fund, collection fee, nonlapse, records, and monthly distribution
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 10 and history note. Creates the Transportation Development District Sales Tax Fund (less one percent collection cost and section 32.087 surety bond premiums), establishes non-state/non-commingled status, interest retention, exemption from section 33.080 lapse, open collection records, and monthly distribution by the tenth day.

headings.title: Refunds, dishonored checks, and post-repeal reserve and closure
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 11 and history note. Authorizes DOR-directed state treasurer refunds and dishonored check redemptions, requires 90-day advance repeal notice with permissive one-year two-percent retention reserve, mandates balance remittance and account closure after one year, and requires refund/redemption notices.

headings.title: Limits on repeal or amendment and voter repeal petitions
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 12 including subdivisions (1)–(2) and history note. headings.title: Voter-approved tolls or fees, ceiling adjustments, and rate variation

headings.title: Ballot form for toll or fee authorization
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 including the statutory ballot schedule table and history note. Prescribes substantial ballot form listing maximum tolls/fees and descriptions.

headings.title: Relocating existing roads and ban on tolling free roads
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and history note. headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 1990 S.B. 479 & 649 § 51, A.L. 1997 S.B. 303, A.L. 1998 S.B. 861). Grants permissive authority for a district to contract and incur liabilities appropriate to accomplish its purposes.

headings.title: Authority to lease or lease-purchase property
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and history note. Permits a district to lease or lease-purchase real or personal property necessary or convenient for its purposes.

headings.title: Authority to borrow money and set interest rates
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and history note. Permits a district to borrow money for its purposes at interest rates determined by the district.

headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history/effective-date notes (L. 1990 S.B. 479 & 649 § 52, Effective 5-30-90). headings.title: Commission assistance or bond issuance for state-merged projects

headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 4 and history/effective-date notes. headings.title: Exclusive district liability and required bond face statement
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 5 and history/effective-date notes. headings.title: State tax exemption for bonds, interest, and proceeds
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 6 and history/effective-date notes. Exempts bonds issued under this section, their interest, and proceeds from all Missouri taxation except the state estate tax.

headings.title: Survey entry onto private property and damage liability

headings.title: Election and ballot form to abolish the district
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 including the ballot language block and history note. Requires submitting an abolishment election in statutory ballot form after project completion and transfer or upon board determination that the project cannot be completed.

headings.title: Commission findings, conditional approval, and maintenance agreement

headings.title: Special trust fund deposit, dedicated transit uses, and investment
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and history note. Requires depositing tax revenues in a special trust fund solely for constructing, purchasing, leasing, maintaining, and operating transportation facilities within the county while the tax remains in effect, with investment of surplus funds under county-fund laws.

headings.title: Voter approval for amendment or repeal and repeal petitions
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 4 and history note. Requires county voter approval per subsection 1 to repeal or amend the tax, and mandates submitting a repeal election upon a petition signed by ten percent of registered voters voting in the last gubernatorial election, stating majority-vote outcomes.

headings.title: Seller privilege tax and combined-rate reporting
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 5 and history note. Imposes a seller privilege tax under sections 144.010 to 144.525 and DOR rules at the approved rate, reported and returned on the combined state, transit authority, and other applicable rate.

headings.title: Director of revenue administration, joint collection, and section 144.285 brackets
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 6 and history note. Assigns administration, collection, enforcement, and operation to the director of revenue jointly with state sales taxes on DOR forms/rules and applies section 144.285 bracket provisions to avoid fractional pennies.

headings.title: State sales tax laws, exemptions, permits, discounts, and penalties
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 7 and history note. Incorporates sections 144.010–144.525 and uniform confidentiality section 32.057, state exemptions, existing permits and certificates (allowing a DOR-prescribed exemption form), chapter 144 retailer discounts, and statutory violation penalties.

headings.title: Retail sale consummation and sourcing rules
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 8 and history note. Deems retail sales consummated at the retailer's place of business, excluding out-of-state deliveries and subsection 12 motor vehicles, trailers, boats, and outboard motors, with multi-location initial-order and employee-workplace rules.

headings.title: Sales tax trust fund, collection fee, open records, and monthly distribution
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 9 and history note. Creates the non-state, non-commingled County Transit Authority Sales Tax Trust Fund (less one percent collection cost after surety bond premiums), mandates open collection records, and requires monthly distribution by the tenth day.

headings.title: Refunds, post-abolition reserve, annual report, and source accounting
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 10 and history note. Authorizes DOR-directed state treasurer refunds and dishonored check redemptions, sets a 90-day abolition notice and permissive one-year two-percent reserve followed by balance remittance and closure, and requires refund notices, an annual DOR management report, and detailed source accounting.

headings.title: Surety bond requirement and premium funding for revenue personnel
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 11 and history note. Requires a $100,000 surety bond or blanket bond for the director of revenue and staff handling tax funds, with premiums paid from the state's retained collection share.

headings.title: Title-application collection for motor vehicles, trailers, boats, and motors
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 12 and history note. Directs DOR collection of sales and use taxes on motor vehicles, trailers, boats, and outboard motors at certificate of title application for in-county applicants (less one percent cost) into the trust fund, deems consummation at the applicant's address, and limits 'boat' to section 306.010 motorboats and vessels.

headings.title: Delinquent tax suit limitations, notices, and authority joinder
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 13 and history note. Applies sections 144.010–144.525 suit limitations, requires ten-day registered or certified DOR notice before attorney general referral so the transit authority may join as party plaintiff, and requires prompt nonpayment notice to the authority.

headings.title: Joining state seized-property sales and priority of proceeds
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 14 and history note. Requires DOR to permit the transit authority to join sales of seized delinquent taxpayer property, applying sale proceeds first to state sums due and the remainder to transit authority sums.

headings.title: Notice to affected businesses of tax rate change
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 15 and history note. Requires a transit authority created under sections 238.400 to 238.412 to notify all affected businesses of the tax rate change caused by imposing the tax.

headings.title: Tax-increase election cost reimbursement in specified charter counties
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 16 and history note. Requires reimbursing county election submission costs from tax funds when a transit authority in a charter county with more than 250,000 and fewer than 350,000 inhabitants submits a sales tax increase proposal that voters approve.
